body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Harman International presented its new car audio system ''drive+play 2 (model: DP 2US) during CES 2007, which allows users to take control of their iPod and ZUNE mp3 player. It has 3.5-inch screen and 5 buttons, and it supports Bluetooth hands-free and SIRIUS satellite radio.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
